description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs. 

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

 

About the Role

We’re seeking a highly experienced Technical Program Manager/Leader to act as the Chief of Staff for the Engineering organization. In this role, you will serve as a strategic operating partner across Engineering, Product, and Design (EPD). You will distill input from stakeholders into a cohesive vision, then turn that vision into clear priorities and drive the execution ceremonies to achieve it.

This is a high-leverage role for a technically credible, exceptionally organized leader who can move comfortably between executive strategy and engineering detail. You will create alignment across leaders and teams, aid the organization in making complex decisions easier to navigate, and ensure that important commitments have clear owners and follow-through. This is not a coordination-only role: success requires sound judgment, strong communication, and the ability to influence without relying on authority.

Core Responsibilities

Strategy, alignment, and operating cadence

  • Synthesize perspectives across EPD and company stakeholders into a clear, cohesive vision and set of priorities.

  • Translate strategy into actionable plans, decision points, ownership, and communications that connect company objectives to EPD execution.

  • Surface competing priorities, gaps, dependencies, and tradeoffs early; facilitate decisions and make sure outcomes are understood by the people responsible for execution.

  • Establish lightweight leadership operating rhythms that improve alignment and follow-through without adding unnecessary process.

  • Prepare concise decision briefs, pre-reads, and executive updates that make complex technical and organizational topics easy to understand.

Organizational artifacts and structure

  • Maintain an evergreen org chart and team charters that clearly describe each team’s mission, scope, interfaces, and ownership.

  • Partner with EPD leaders and relevant People, Recruiting, and Finance partners to make hiring tradeoffs visible and keep plans current.

  • Identify organizational gaps, overlaps, or unclear ownership and help leaders evaluate practical options as the organization evolves.

What Success Looks Like

  • EPD leaders and key stakeholders share a coherent understanding of strategy, priorities, and the decisions needed to move forward.

  • The EPD-led company All-Hands consistently communicates a clear, credible narrative and results in visible follow-through.

  • The org chart, team charters, ownership boundaries, and integrated hiring plan remain accurate and useful as the organization changes.

  • Principal Engineers and Architects have a productive community for resolving cross-cutting questions, documenting decisions, and coordinating technical direction.

  • Leadership operating mechanisms create clarity and accountability while remaining lightweight and useful to the teams doing the work.

What You’ll Bring

  • Typically 10+ years of experience in technical program management, strategic operations, a Chief of Staff role, or a comparable role in a SaaS organization.

  • A track record of turning ambiguous, multi-stakeholder strategy into clear plans, decisions, ownership, and measurable execution.

  • Experience partnering with senior Engineering and Product leaders and influencing across teams without direct authority.

  • Strong technical fluency and a practical understanding of software development, engineering organizations, and architectural tradeoffs; you can engage credibly with senior engineers without needing to make technical decisions for them.

  • Experience building or improving organizational operating mechanisms, such as planning cadences, team charters, org models, capacity plans, or executive communications.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, including the ability to distill complexity into a clear narrative for both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Strong judgment, discretion, and follow-through when handling sensitive information, competing priorities, and high-stakes decisions.

  • A pragmatic, low-ego approach to resolving disagreement, building trust, and helping teams make progress.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in cybersecurity, SaaS, cloud, platform, or infrastructure organizations.

  • Experience supporting or facilitating a community of Principal Engineers, Architects, or other senior technical leaders.

  • Experience in a high-growth or distributed organization where operating models and team boundaries evolve quickly.

  • A background in software engineering or another technical discipline.

Travel Required

Horizon3 is a remote company. This role may require up to 15% travel to be successful.

Perks of Horizon3

  • Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

  • Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

  • Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

  • Hybrid & Remote Work: We embrace a mix of remote and hybrid work models depending on role and location, including our Chicago office, where some roles require regular in-office presence.

  • Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.

Compensation and Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

In accordance with various State’s transparency regulations, we provide the following salary range information for this position:

  • Base salary range: $250,000–$275,000 annually. The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate’s location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills.

  • Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.

You Belong Here

Horizon3 is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. 

Application Note

In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.
